items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I mean this man is the leader. He pay me.

ctx.x: All right. So Dizzy say, you know, one of these days this man going to start playing his tenor, and you going to look for his head, going to be in the middle of the floor, and the saxophone in the band. I said, don't do that. Don't pay no mind. Do your work and play your trumpet. Forget about it. He don't pay you. Calloway going to pay you.
